It is commonly known as '''Yoshida Shrine'''. {{nihongo|'''Sumetaruho Yoshida-ōkamigū'''|皇足穂吉田大御神宮}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932|lt=Engishiki Jinmyōchō}}. == Overview ==
As its name appears in the shrine register (Jinmyōchō) of the {{ill|Engishiki|ar|إنجيشيكي (كتاب ياباني)|de|Engishiki|es|Engishiki|fr|Engishiki|he|אנגישיקי|id|Engishiki|it|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|ko|엔기시키|min|Engishiki|mr|इंगिशिकी|nl|Engishiki|pt|Engishiki|ru|Энгисики|simple|Engishiki|tr|Engishiki|uk|Енґісікі|zh|延喜式|qid=Q1342448}} from {{ill|927|ab|927|af|927|am|927 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|927|ar|927|ary|927|ast|927|avk|927|az|927|azb|۹۲۷ (میلادی)|bar|927|bcl|927|be|927|be_x_old|927|bg|927|bn|৯২৭|bpy|মারি ৯২৭|br|927|bs|927.|ca|927|cdo|927 nièng|ceb|927|ckb|٩٢٧|crh|927|cs|927|csb|927|cv|927|cy|927|da|927|de|927|el|927|eml|927|eo|927|es|927|et|927|eu|927|fa|۹۲۷ (میلادی)|fi|927|fo|927|fr|927|fy|927|ga|927|gan|927年|gd|927|gl|927|he|927|hi|927|hr|927.|ht|927 (almanak jilyen)|hu|927|hy|927|id|927|ilo|927|io|927|is|927|it|927|ja|927年|jv|927|ka|927|kaa|927|kk|927 жыл|ko|927년|la|927|lb|927|lij|927|lmo|927|lt|927 m.|lv|927. gads|map_bms|927|mdf|927|mg|927|mhr|927|mi|927|mk|927|mr|इ.स. ९२७|mrj|927 и|ms|927|mzn|۹۲۷|nah|927|nap|927|nds|927|new|सन् ९२७|nl|927|nn|927|no|927|nrm|927|nso|927|oc|927|or|୯୨୭|os|927-æм аз|pl|927|pnb|927|pt|927|qu|927|ro|927|ru|927 год|rue|927|sa|९२७|scn|927|sd|927ع|se|927|sh|927.|shn|927|si|927|sk|927|smn|927|sq|927|sr|927|su|927|sv|927|sw|927|tg|Соли 927|th|พ.ศ. 1470|tk|927|tl|927|tly|927|tr|927|tt|927 ел|uk|927|ur|927ء|uz|927|vec|927|vi|927|war|927|wuu|927年|xmf|927|zh|927年|zh_min_nan|927 nî|zh_yue|927年|qid=Q30470}} ({{ill|Enchō|de|Enchō|fa|انچو|fr|Ère Enchō|ia|Encho|id|Enchō|ja|延長 (元号)|ko|엔초|ru|Энтё|simple|Enchō|sr|Енчо|tr|Enchō|uk|Ентьо|zh|延長 (日本)|zh_yue|延長 (年號)|qid=Q1327274|lt=Enchō}} 5), the shrine has a long history.

Originally, it was enshrined about 1 km to the east in Komachi (present-day {{ill|Yoshida|ja|吉田 (長野市)|qid=Q11413505|lt=Yoshida}} 3-chōme). However, because the area was frequently flooded by the {{ill|Asa River|ceb|Asa Kawa (suba sa Hapon, Nagano-ken)|ja|浅川 (長野県)|qid=Q11557083|lt=Asakawa}} and because the {{ill|Hokkoku Kaidō|fa|هوکوکو کایدو|fr|Hokkoku Kaidō|ja|北国街道 (信越)|zh|北國街道 (信越)|qid=Q3069767|lt=Hokkoku Kaidō}} was newly developed, the shrine was relocated during the {{ill|Keichō|ca|Keichō|es|Keichō|fa|کیچو (دوره)|fr|Ère Keichō|id|Keichō|it|Keichō|ja|慶長|ko|게이초|ru|Кэйтё|simple|Keichō|sr|Кеичо|sv|Keichō|th|เคโช|tr|Keichō|uk|Кейтьо|zh|慶長|qid=Q1328185}} era to its current site along the Hokkoku Kaidō (Uemachi, present-day Yoshida 1-chōme).<ref name="weekly-nagano">[http://weekly-nagano.main.jp/2010/06/97.html 097 Yoshida Shrine—The lively precincts during the Festival of the Gods] - Weekly Nagano</ref> At the time of this relocation, nearby shrines were consolidated, resulting in the unusual configuration of approximately 100 auxiliary shrines of various sizes within the precincts.<ref name="weekly-nagano" />

The sacred {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=goshinboku}} {{ill|Ginkgo biloba|af|Ginkgo|ar|جنكة بيلوبا|arz|جنكه بيلوبا|ast|Ginkgo biloba|az|İkidilim ginkqo|ban|Ginkgo biloba|bcl|Ginkgo biloba|be|Гінкга|be_x_old|Гінкга двухлопасьцевы|bg|Гинко билоба|br|Ginkgo biloba|ca|Ginkgo biloba|ceb|Ginkgo biloba|cs|Jinan dvoulaločný|cy|Coeden ginco|da|Tempeltræ|de|Ginkgo|dsb|Rozdwójony ginkgo|el|Γκίγκο|es|Ginkgo biloba|et|Hõlmikpuu|eu|Ginkgo|fa|کهن‌دار|fi|Neidonhiuspuu|fiu_vro|Hõlmikpuu|fr|Ginkgo biloba|frr|Ginkgo biloba|gl|Xinkgo|haw|Nanahana|he|גינקו דו-אונתי|hi|जिन्को बाइलोबा|hr|Dvorežnjasti ginko|hsb|Rozdwojeny ginkgo|hu|Páfrányfenyő|hy|Գինկգո|hyw|Ճինքկօ|id|Ginkgo biloba|is|Musteristré|it|Ginkgo biloba|ja|イチョウ|jv|Ginkgo biloba|kn|ಗಿಂಕ್ಗೊ ಬಿಲೋಬ|ko|은행나무|koi|Гинкго|kv|Гинкго|la|Ginkgo biloba|lb|Ginkgo|lfn|Ginco|li|Ginkgo|lmo|Ginkgo biloba|lt|Dviskiautis ginkmedis|lv|Divdaivu ginks|mk|Гинко|ml|ജിൻകോ ബൈലൊബ|mrj|Гинкго|ms|Ginkgo biloba|nl|Japanse notenboom|nn|Tempeltre|no|Tempeltre|oc|Ginkgo biloba|pa|ਗਿੰਕਗੋ|pl|Miłorząb dwuklapowy|pms|Ginkgo biloba|pnb|گنکگو|ps|جينکگو بيلوبا|pt|Ginkgo biloba|ro|Arborele pagodelor|roa_tara|Ginkgo biloba|ru|Гинкго двулопастной|sco|Ginkgo biloba|sh|Ginko|si|Ginkgo biloba|sk|Ginko dvojlaločné|sl|Dvokrpi ginko|sr|Гинко|sv|Ginkgo|szy|nipaluma-insin|ta|பாசில் மரம்|te|గిన్‌కోగో వృక్షం|th|แปะก๊วย|tl|Ginkgo biloba|tr|Mabet ağacı|udm|Гинкго|uk|Ґінкго дволопатеве|uz|Ginkgo|vi|Bạch quả|war|Ginkgo biloba|wuu|银杏|zh|银杏|zh_min_nan|Gîn-hēng|zh_yue|白果|qid=Q43284}} (described below) that stood at the former site was left in place even after the relocation and remains vigorous to this day.

== The Yoshida Ginkgo ==
The {{ill|Ginkgo biloba|af|Ginkgo|ar|جنكة بيلوبا|arz|جنكه بيلوبا|ast|Ginkgo biloba|az|İkidilim ginkqo|ban|Ginkgo biloba|bcl|Ginkgo biloba|be|Гінкга|be_x_old|Гінкга двухлопасьцевы|bg|Гинко билоба|br|Ginkgo biloba|ca|Ginkgo biloba|ceb|Ginkgo biloba|cs|Jinan dvoulaločný|cy|Coeden ginco|da|Tempeltræ|de|Ginkgo|dsb|Rozdwójony ginkgo|el|Γκίγκο|es|Ginkgo biloba|et|Hõlmikpuu|eu|Ginkgo|fa|کهن‌دار|fi|Neidonhiuspuu|fiu_vro|Hõlmikpuu|fr|Ginkgo biloba|frr|Ginkgo biloba|gl|Xinkgo|haw|Nanahana|he|גינקו דו-אונתי|hi|जिन्को बाइलोबा|hr|Dvorežnjasti ginko|hsb|Rozdwojeny ginkgo|hu|Páfrányfenyő|hy|Գինկգո|hyw|Ճինքկօ|id|Ginkgo biloba|is|Musteristré|it|Ginkgo biloba|ja|イチョウ|jv|Ginkgo biloba|kn|ಗಿಂಕ್ಗೊ ಬಿಲೋಬ|ko|은행나무|koi|Гинкго|kv|Гинкго|la|Ginkgo biloba|lb|Ginkgo|lfn|Ginco|li|Ginkgo|lmo|Ginkgo biloba|lt|Dviskiautis ginkmedis|lv|Divdaivu ginks|mk|Гинко|ml|ജിൻകോ ബൈലൊബ|mrj|Гинкго|ms|Ginkgo biloba|nl|Japanse notenboom|nn|Tempeltre|no|Tempeltre|oc|Ginkgo biloba|pa|ਗਿੰਕਗੋ|pl|Miłorząb dwuklapowy|pms|Ginkgo biloba|pnb|گنکگو|ps|جينکگو بيلوبا|pt|Ginkgo biloba|ro|Arborele pagodelor|roa_tara|Ginkgo biloba|ru|Гинкго двулопастной|sco|Ginkgo biloba|sh|Ginko|si|Ginkgo biloba|sk|Ginko dvojlaločné|sl|Dvokrpi ginko|sr|Гинко|sv|Ginkgo|szy|nipaluma-insin|ta|பாசில் மரம்|te|గిన్‌కోగో వృక్షం|th|แปะก๊วย|tl|Ginkgo biloba|tr|Mabet ağacı|udm|Гинкго|uk|Ґінкго дволопатеве|uz|Ginkgo|vi|Bạch quả|war|Ginkgo biloba|wuu|银杏|zh|银杏|zh_min_nan|Gîn-hēng|zh_yue|白果|qid=Q43284}} tree that still remains at the former shrine site is estimated to be 900 years old, with a height of 32 m, a trunk circumference at eye level of 8.6 m, and a branch spread of 11–15 m—an enormous tree.<ref name="city">[http://www.city.nagano.nagano.jp/uploaded/attachment/5599.pdf Yoshida Ginkgo　Ginkgo tree in Yoshida] - Cultural Properties Division, Board of Education, Nagano City</ref> Before World War II it was designated a {{ill|Natural monument|ar|نصب تذكاري طبيعي|ast|Monumentu natural|ba|Тәбиғәт ҡомартҡыһы|be|Помнікі прыроды|be_x_old|Помнік прыроды|bg|Природна забележителност|bs|Spomenik prirode|ca|Monument natural|cs|Přírodní památka|da|Naturmonument|de|Naturdenkmal|eo|Naturmemorindaĵo|es|Monumento natural|et|Loodusmälestis|eu|Monumentu natural|fa|یادمان طبیعی|fi|Luonnonmuistomerkki|fr|Monument naturel|gl|Monumento natural|hr|Spomenik prirode|hy|Բնության հուշարձան|id|Monumen alam|is|Náttúruvætti|it|Monumento naturale|ja|天然記念物|ka|ბუნების ძეგლი|kk|Табиғат ескерткіші|ko|천연기념물|lv|Dabas piemineklis|mk|Споменик на природата|nl|Natuurmonument|nn|Naturminne|no|Naturminne|pl|Pomnik przyrody|pt|Monumento natural|ro|Monument al naturii|ru|Памятник природы|sh|Spomenik prirode|sk|Prírodná pamiatka|sl|Naravni spomenik|sq|Monument natyror|sr|Споменик природе|sv|Naturminne|th|อนุสรณ์สถานทางธรรมชาติ|tr|Tabiat anıtı|uk|Пам'ятка природи|uz|Tabiat yodgorliklari|zh|自然紀念物|qid=Q23790}} of Nagano Prefecture, and it is currently designated a Natural Monument of Nagano City.

It is a male tree and does not bear fruit, but according to legend, if its bark is soaked in water and the water is given to a mother to drink, her {{ill|Breast milk|ar|حليب الثدي|ast|Lleche materno|az|Ana südü|be|Жаночае малако|be_x_old|Жаночае малако|bg|Кърма|bn|বুকের দুধ|bs|Majčino mlijeko|ca|Llet materna|ckb|شیری دایک|cs|Mateřské mléko|cy|Llaeth y fron|da|Modermælk|de|Muttermilch|diq|Şıtê mae|dv|ހޯމޯން ކިރުގެ ޙުކުމް އިސްލާމީ ނަޒަރަކުން|el|Μητρικό γάλα|eo|Patrina lakto|es|Leche materna|et|Rinnapiim|eu|Ama-esne|fa|شیر مادر|fi|Äidinmaito|fr|Lait maternel humain|ga|Bainne cíche|gl|Leite humano|he|חלב אם|hi|मां का दूध|hu|Anyatej|hy|Կրծքի կաթ|hyw|Կուրծքի Կաթը|id|Air susu ibu|ilo|Gatas ti suso|it|Latte materno|ja|母乳|jv|Banyu susu ibu|ko|모유|ky|Эмчек сүтү|lb|Spënn|lt|Motinos pienas|lv|Mātes piens|ml|മുലപ്പാൽ|ms|Susu ibu|nds|Tittmelk|ne|आमाको दूध|nl|Moedermelk|no|Morsmelk|pa|ਮਾਂ ਦਾ ਦੁੱਧ|pfl|Muttermilch|pt|Leite materno|qu|Ñukñu|ro|Lapte matern|ru|Женское молоко|sk|Materské mlieko|sl|Materino mleko|sr|Мајчино млеко|su|Cai Susu Indung|sv|Bröstmjölk|sw|Maziwa ya mama|ta|தாய்ப்பால்|te|తల్లిపాలు|th|นมจากเต้านม|tk|Ene süýdi|tn|Mashi a lebele|tr|Anne sütü|ug|ئانا سۈتى|uk|Грудне молоко|ur|ماں کا دودھ|uz|Ona suti|vi|Sữa mẹ|war|Gatas han iroy|wuu|母乳|zh|母乳|zh_yue|人奶|qid=Q22728}} will flow. For this reason, it is called the “Milk Ginkgo.”<ref name="city" />
